changelog: MCP 1.7.0: signed intent (pass cart to bind the card to what it is for), signed execution receipt with per-field provenance, and a fixed 14-class failure_class enum replacing free-text failure reports.
summary: Pay for things safely from your agent — gasless USDC on Base plus JIT single-use virtual cards via the Z-Zero MCP server. Card data never enters the model context, and no payment executes without explicit human approval.
